title: fullyParallel with 4 workers races the shared store reset
summary: playwright.config.ts enables fullyParallel and 4 workers while each test still resets one shared, server-side in-process store in beforeEach; concurrent workers reset the store under one another, so tests observe wiped or leftover tasks (e.g. the create test's counter expectation). This is an environment/config misconfiguration, not an app bug.

expectedFailure.testTitle: creating a task shows it in the list and updates the counter
